# Every test the DB-less green list (run.sh) skips, as the JUnit report names
# it, under the reason it skips. check_skips.py fails the run on a skip missing
# here and on an entry here that no longer skips. A new entry needs its reason.

# e6ircd has no server password: who a client is comes from SASL, so the
# controller refuses a PASS-configured server.
irctest.server_tests.connection_registration.PasswordedConnectionRegistrationTestCase::testNoPassword
irctest.server_tests.connection_registration.PasswordedConnectionRegistrationTestCase::testPassBeforeNickuser
irctest.server_tests.connection_registration.PasswordedConnectionRegistrationTestCase::testWrongPassword

# A bare INVITE is ERR_NEEDMOREPARAMS, as on Solanum and Libera: there is no
# list of one's pending invitations.
irctest.server_tests.invite.InviteTestCase::testInviteList

# The controller states no ISUPPORT values for irctest to compare; the 005
# burst is held to the vendored Libera snapshot by tests/libera_compat.rs.
irctest.server_tests.isupport.IsupportTestCase::testValues

# The controller cannot move the e6ircd process's clock (no faketime).
irctest.server_tests.list.FaketimeListTestCase::testListCreationTime
irctest.server_tests.list.FaketimeListTestCase::testListTopicTime

# NAMES takes one channel (TARGMAX NAMES:1, as on Libera).
irctest.server_tests.names.NamesTestCase::testNamesMultipleChannels2812

# Only channel operators and voiced members may send to @#chan / +#chan.
irctest.server_tests.statusmsg.StatusmsgTestCase::testStatusmsgFromRegular

# Every IRC line is UTF-8, over /ws/irc as over TCP.
irctest.server_tests.websocket.WebsocketTestCase::testReceiveNonUtf8Text
irctest.server_tests.websocket.WebsocketTestCase::testSendNonUtf8Text

# irctest itself marks these skipped ("Not consistently implemented").
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoRealNameSpaces
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoUsernameRealName[hostname]
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoUsernameRealName[realname-mask]
irctest.server_tests.who.WhoTestCase::testWhoUsernameRealName[username]
